body:
**Blocked by:** none
**Model tier:** medium

## Context

Model tier rationale: This repairs one test-local override lifecycle and verifies its exceptional exit without changing the dispatcher.

- PR #1146, finding `421021068d`, `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/gmailWatchLifecycle.test.ts:357`: The override is restored only at the last statement of the test, so an assertion or await failure leaves its implementation installed; mockClear does not restore it.

## Task

Make the failing-target enqueue override in the dispatcher test exception-safe: put its entire lifetime under guaranteed cleanup that restores the actual enqueueMailAccountSync implementation even if the test body rejects. Remove the success-only final restore. Keep implementation restoration distinct from clearing calls and returning timers to real time. Add a passing regression that deliberately rejects inside the same override scope, catches the sentinel outside it, and proves the next real enqueue uses the actual implementation. A helper needed to exercise that scope must remain local to this test file and serve only this enqueue override.

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/gmailWatchLifecycle.test.ts (dispatcher enqueue override, guaranteed restoration and focused regression only)

## Scope

### In scope

Ownership and cleanup of the reported enqueue mock implementation.

### Out of scope

Dispatcher production behavior, other transport overrides, generalized mocking infrastructure and unrelated timer cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria

- For finding `421021068d`, both normal completion and a deliberate body rejection restore the actual enqueue implementation; a subsequent enqueue reaches the real queued-job behavior. The sentinel rejection remains observable to the caller and the existing partial-target failure test still passes.
